title: A seller's earnings on screen match their payout once the card fee passes through

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-18: "is card processing taken into consideration?" then "make all the changes site wide to the new system" (project thread: Rethink our take rates). ADR-1978.

detail: The earnings rollups in lib/commerce/orders.ts work a net as gross minus Frequency's fee in several places, and the order receipt and earnings screens show it. From the pass-through date a sale also loses the card fee before it reaches the seller, so every net on screen would read higher than the payout. Work: take the card fee each sale carried off the net (cardFeeCentsAt / sellerFeesAt in lib/billing/card-fee.ts, from the sale's amount and created time, zero before the date), show it as its own line next to Frequency's fee, and keep feeCents meaning Frequency's fee. This row is a gate on setting the date (docs/RUNBOOKS.md). DONE 2026-11-19: SpaceEarnings carries cardFeeCents (per sale, cardFeeCentsAt from its amount and time, pro rata on a partial refund), netCents is gross minus Frequency's fee and the card fee in every arm (settleNet), and the shop Orders tab shows the card fee as its own card when it is above zero. Split shares carry none until LIVE-2421 records which share bore it.

verify.note: Fails until the earnings views subtract the card fee a sale carried.
